relationship_to_J363: Adds an immediate interactive client-side staging milestone; preserves the broader J363 retention backlog.

reconciliation.production: Latest observed production is v3.430.0, deployment dpl_72b2G579GhCPSS7A6AoLHrypQa91. The mandate's v3.419.0 reference is historical, not an instruction to downgrade or replace the current rollback records.
reconciliation.empty_feed: Use [] only in the isolated client-side staging build. Preserve production feeds, sealed candidates and historical evidence. Record any existing local feed before replacing a staging copy.
reconciliation.network: Calculations and fixtures run locally without fetch/XHR or third-party SDKs. Explicit user-click outbound navigation/share is separate from calculation; no automatic redirects or background tracking.
reconciliation.claims: The specified cinema prices, meal listings, bridge surcharges, student benefits and stack codes are not established facts merely because they appear in this mandate. Implement interactive scenarios immediately with visible simulation labels and editable inputs. Promote to factual listings only from existing supporting evidence; evidence acquisition does not block the simulator.

source_and_sync.rule: Edit canonical source first, then synchronize exact bytes and record SHA-256 equality across all three. Preserve unrelated user changes. Build a separate preview payload and do not use vercel --prod.

modules.name: calculateDynamicStack
requirements: Order input 20000..500000 VND; configurable shop/platform percentage or fixed discounts, minimum spend, caps, stacking eligibility and shipping credit.
Show item subtotal, each applied/rejected discount with reason, shipping and final payable amount; cap credits to eligible amounts and prevent negative payable totals.
Measure compute-only duration separately from rendering; target <=1ms with median/p95/max and device context.

Only copy actual evidence-backed codes; simulated codes are visibly examples and cannot be presented as redeemable. Confetti follows clipboard success, honors reduced motion and has a text status fallback.

modules.name: Lunch three-app comparison
requirements: Slider 20000..200000 VND; ShopeeFood/GrabFood/BeFood columns with user-editable delivery, service, discount and optional bridge surcharge assumptions.
Use Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh time windows [11:30,12:30) and [16:30,18:30); allow test-clock injection and manual bridge choice without GPS.
Mark results as estimates from entered assumptions, not live app quotes. Peak-hour warning must not claim a universal bridge fee; apply a fee only when explicitly entered or supported.

modules.name: Cinema calendar and Split Bill Pro
requirements: Render requested T2 Metiz 45K, T3 Galaxy 50K, T4 CGV 75K, T5 Starlight 45K as clearly labeled scenario fixtures unless evidence supports each exact day, price and Da Nang scope.
Calculate integer VND groups with exact total conservation and explicit remainder allocation. Export Canvas PNG boarding pass and copyable message with production link.
User-initiated native share when supported; PNG download and message-copy fallback. Omit identity/free text from default export; no contacts or GPS access.

modules.name: Meals <=25K and student benefits
requirements: Build ten listing slots and filters for Bach Khoa, DUE, Su Pham and Duy Tan. Populate genuine names, prices, hotline and map destinations only from existing verified records; empty slots remain explicitly awaiting data and do not count as verified eateries.
Use user-click map links instead of network-loaded maps. No invented phone numbers, addresses or <=25K claims.

Build guide panels for GitHub, Spotify, Notion and DanaBus with eligibility, activation steps and source links. Distinguish free benefits, trials, student discounts and subsidized fares; do not label every service 0 VND. Unverified instructions remain draft.

modules.name: dispatchSmartAffiliate
requirements: Build disabled-by-default provider adapters for Shopee/Lazada/Grab with allowlisted HTTPS destinations and explicit user-click activation.
Construct sub1=campus, sub2=cluster, sub3=timestamp from coarse selected values; URL-encode them, exclude PII and keep them local in dry-run mode.

Provider-specific tracking requires approved publisher configuration; arbitrary sub parameters alone do not establish commission attribution. Provide visible dry-run destination preview and working official web fallback.
No live affiliate activation, automatic navigation or claimed revenue in this milestone.
Record preview URL, deployment ID, served hashes, triple parity, [] staging-feed check, runner hash, timestamp and exact test environment.
Exercise actual controls, boundaries and error paths at 390px and desktop; 0 TypeError/ReferenceError, no overflow, keyboard usability and touch targets >=44px.
Measure text contrast against WCAG AA thresholds (4.5:1 normal / 3:1 large); separately report AAA coverage. Do not equate a visual impression with compliance.
Record layout-shift observations and frame times during representative interactions; target CLS=0 and 60FPS, disclose measured results and device limitations.
Observe network requests during interaction to verify local computation; test clipboard denial, reduced motion, image download and share fallback.
Distinguish mobile viewport emulation from a physical-phone test. Provide screenshot evidence and report any physical-device test not performed.

handoff: Provide staging URL, reproducible runner, receipt, screenshots, exact changed files and actual completion time for CEO interaction review. This dispatch is an issued work order, not evidence that Antigravity has started or completed execution.
